# Crate map

<!-- Generated by scripts/crate_map.py from `cargo metadata`. Do not edit by hand:
     run `python3 scripts/crate_map.py` and commit the result. -->

The workspace has 117 crates. Each row shows the crate's Cargo `description`,
the workspace crates that depend on it directly (**consumers**, without the `temps-`
prefix; dev-dependencies are not counted) and the binaries it builds.

To add a crate: give its `Cargo.toml` a one-line `description`, assign it a layer
in `LAYERS` in `scripts/crate_map.py`, then run `python3 scripts/crate_map.py`.
CI runs `python3 scripts/crate_map.py --check`, which fails when this file is
stale, a crate has no description, or a crate has no layer.

## Layers

A crate may depend on crates in a lower tier and on peers in its own tier.
[Edges against the layer order](#edges-against-the-layer-order) lists the exceptions.

| Layer | Tier | Crates | What lives there |
|---|---|---|---|
| [library](#library) | 0 | 9 | Self-contained libraries, leaf types and wire protocols with few or no internal dependencies. |
| [foundation](#foundation) | 1 | 8 | Shared types, persistence, settings and auth that nearly every crate builds on. |
| [toolkit](#toolkit) | 2 | 3 | Stateless helper libraries built on the foundation: project detection, screenshots, the plugin SDK. |
| [runtime](#runtime) | 2 | 20 | Containers, networking, DNS and the processes that run on worker nodes and inside sandboxes. |
| [traffic](#traffic) | 2 | 5 | The request path: reverse proxy, edge cache, route table and bot protection. |
| [data-browser](#data-browser) | 2 | 5 | The data browser: one trait and a driver per external datastore. |
| [domain](#domain) | 3 | 32 | Control-plane features: a service layer plus HTTP handlers for one product area. |
| [observability](#observability) | 3 | 12 | Analytics, error tracking, OpenTelemetry, metrics and logs: ingest, storage and queries. |
| [ai](#ai) | 3 | 8 | AI foundation, agents, chat, gateway and the MCP surfaces. |
| [import](#import) | 3 | 9 | Importing workloads from other platforms: the orchestrator and one adapter per platform. |
| [application](#application) | 4 | 1 | Composition roots that wire the crates into the shipped binaries. |
| [example](#example) | 4 | 4 | Example external plugins built on the plugin SDK. |
| [test-support](#test-support) | 4 | 1 | Crates used only by tests. |

## Edges against the layer order

Dependencies on a crate in a higher tier. Each one widens what a change rebuilds;
cut them rather than adding more.

| Crate | Depends on |
|---|---|
| `temps-entities` (foundation) | `temps-workload-ingress` (runtime) |
| `temps-node-agent` (runtime) | `temps-ai-agents` (ai) |
| `temps-node-agent` (runtime) | `temps-external-plugins` (domain) |
| `temps-node-agent` (runtime) | `temps-metrics` (observability) |
| `temps-node-agent` (runtime) | `temps-providers` (domain) |
| `temps-node-agent` (runtime) | `temps-vulnerability-scanner` (domain) |
| `temps-proxy` (traffic) | `temps-analytics` (observability) |
| `temps-proxy` (traffic) | `temps-geo` (domain) |
| `temps-proxy` (traffic) | `temps-metrics` (observability) |
